annotations.text:
SCORECARD — the system

Ground inverts to paper #ECEAE4 on black chrome. Archivo 900 for anything numeric or declarative; Geist Mono for every label, meta and tag. Zero radii throughout. Two rule weights only: 1px hairline inside a block, 3px between blocks. One accent — #D93C11 — reserved for the live thing (current question, your turn, the primary action). Green #146C3A appears once, on the result.

INTERVIEW — the screen I hadn't drawn

Not chat bubbles: a transcript ledger. A fixed 148px gutter numbers every turn (Q01 / A01) so the interview reads as a record, and the composer sits in the same grid as the answers — you type where your answer will land. The current question carries the accent bar. Progress shows as segments, not a percentage, because the interviewer decides the length.

REPORT — the payoff

The 176px numeral is the whole point of this direction. The band bar marks 55 (pass) in accent so the result is legible without reading a word. What landed / what didn't sit side by side at equal weight — the honesty is the product.

SAVE SCORECARD is new and NOT built: flag if you want it, it would need the downloads path.

PHONE — 390px

The 148px gutter can't survive here, so the turn label moves above the text and the ledger keeps its rules. Headline sizes drop 96 → 40. Every control clears 44px. SEND becomes a full-width bar rather than a side button.

The three directions you didn't pick, kept so you can still borrow from them — A's serif headline scale or B's report density would both graft onto Scorecard without much fight.

D here is the original sketch; the built-out version is on the Scorecard page.
